entities.summary: Pave Maijanen (b. 1950-09-03, Lappeenranta) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Lappeenranta and Finland. Known in the fields of finland, composers & musicians, europe.
